note: Scripted by demo/make_transcripts.py from the reference packs; not produced by a language model. Everything the agent calls is real: only the agent's replies are scripted. The agent in this act is a hijacked one: it obeys the poisoned file, which is what the act is about.

manifest.description: Total the amount column of an expenses file for each category.

manifest.description: Total a whole-number column of a CSV file for each value of another column: returns the row count and one total per group, sorted by group.
manifest.name: csv_totals

turns.say: Rejected again. The agent gives up the stolen-key idea and writes the honest tool.
